layers.name: Project Config & Top-Level Docs
layers.description: Repository configuration, manifests, root documentation, release metadata, and design notes outside excluded directories.

layers.name: Autoresearch Evaluation
layers.description: Research/evaluation scripts, task sets, presets, and reliability experiments.

layers.name: Recorder System
layers.description: High-level recorder services, dashboard backend, recorder-core package, sample ranking, init, analyze, and verify boundaries.

layers.name: Browser Bridge Extension
layers.description: Chrome extension service worker, CDP bridge, tab leases, URL policy, and browser-side command execution.

layers.name: CLI Core
layers.description: Top-level command registration, adapter discovery, execution, output formatting, plugin management, and runtime helpers.

layers.name: Browser & Daemon Runtime
layers.description: Local daemon, browser session routing, CDP/page abstractions, URL policy, tab targeting, and browser automation primitives.

layers.name: Capture, Pipeline & Observability
layers.description: Network/article/media download pipeline, observation sessions, artifacts, retention, and capture processing.

tour.title: CLI startup and command surface
tour.description: Start at the executable entry point and command registration layer to understand how byCLI boots, discovers adapters, and exposes commands.

tour.title: Browser bridge and daemon path
tour.description: Follow the local daemon and browser abstractions that route CLI browser commands into Chrome/CDP or the extension bridge.

tour.title: Extension-side automation
tour.description: Inspect the Chrome extension service worker and CDP helper that manage tab leases, navigation, screenshots, cookies, and network capture.

tour.title: Capture and pipeline services
tour.description: Review the pipeline, download, and observation modules that collect browser evidence and process fetched or captured content.

tour.title: Recorder architecture
tour.description: Use the recorder backend and recorder-core package to understand the high-level capture, ranking, init, analyze, and verify workflow.
